newsitem.title: USA: FAA lets ValuJet serve more Fla. airports.
newsitem.headline: FAA lets ValuJet serve more Fla. airports.

text.p: The Federal Aviation Administration Friday gave Valujet Airlines approval to operate into West Palm Beach airport and Southwest Florida regional Airport at Ft. Myers, Florida.

The regulator said it had not given approval for Valujet to operate any additional aircraft although it is continuing to review the airline's request to add five aircraft to its fleet. Valujet currently flies 15 aircraft to 17 cities.
The FAA said the approval followed its audit of Valujet's maintenance records, procedures and facilities at each airport.
